name: Sonetto
bio: Archetype: DMG Buff, Crowd-Control. ⌽ Can apply consistent +DMG Dealt and -DMG Taken (and extra Penetration Rate for herself) with S2. ⌽ The [Disarm] on S1 makes opponents with a lot of damage easy to handle. ⌽ Using her own buffs, her Ult can hit extremely hard even in late game. ⌽ Flexible (and free!) unit that can find herself in a lot of different teams.
